test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Analgesic medicines are used for _________________.

options.text: correcting deficiencies due to vitamins and nutrients
killing or weakening microbes and infections

solution:
The correct answer is __**reducing pain and in fever**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Analgesic medicines** are primarily used to **alleviate pain**.
 
• They work by **blocking pain signals** from reaching the brain or by interfering with the brain’s interpretation of these signals.
 
• Analgesics are commonly used to treat conditions such as **headaches, muscle pain, arthritis, and other chronic pain conditions**.
 
• Examples of analgesic medicines include **paracetamol (acetaminophen), ibuprofen, and aspirin**.
 
• Some analgesics, such as **opioids**, are prescribed for more severe pain and must be used under medical supervision due to their potential for **addiction and side effects**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **supporting physiological functions**__

 __
 
• Medicines that **support physiological functions** are generally known as **supportive or adjunctive therapies**.
 
• They help in maintaining the **normal functioning of the body** or enhancing the effectiveness of other treatments.
 
 
 
• **correcting deficiencies due to vitamins and nutrients**__
 __
 
• Medicines for **correcting deficiencies** include **vitamin supplements and nutritional supplements**.
 
• These are used when there is a lack of essential nutrients in the body, leading to conditions like **scurvy (vitamin C deficiency) or rickets (vitamin D deficiency)**.
 
 
 
• **killing or weakening microbes and infections**__
 
 
• Medicines that **kill or weaken microbes** are known as **antimicrobials**, which include **antibiotics, antivirals, antifungals, and antiparasitics**.
 
• These medicines are used to treat **infections** caused by various pathogens such as **bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites**.
